claims.text: Stop allopurinol at the first skin rash or other sign of hypersensitivity.
claims.quote: Discontinue Allopurinol Tablets at the first appearance of skin rash or other signs of hypersensitivity reaction.

claims.text: Raises mercaptopurine and azathioprine exposure (myelosuppression): reduce their dose.
claims.quote: Concomitant use with allopurinol increases the exposure of either mercaptopurine or azathioprine which may increase the risk of myelosuppression. Reduce the dosage of mercaptopurine or azathioprine as recommended in their respective prescribing information when used concomitantly with Allopurinol Tablets

claims.text: Bendamustine, thiazides, ampicillin and amoxicillin may raise the risk of serious skin reactions.
claims.quote: The following drugs may increase the risk of serious skin reactions: bendamustine, thiazide diuretics, ampicillin and amoxicillin.

claims.text: Keep fluid intake high enough for a urine output of at least 2 liters/day (helps avoid xanthine stones; with uricosurics, helps prevent urate precipitation).
claims.quote: Maintain fluid intake sufficient to yield a urinary output of at least 2 liters per day of neutral or, preferably, slightly alkaline urine to avoid the possibility of formation of xanthine calculi and help prevent renal precipitation of urates in patients receiving concomitant uricosuric agents.
